scope: Independent source review of eight detached synthetic controls: positive constructor prerequisites, generated ordinary File head, actual raw block-array reference indices, self/detail closure, and typed refusal layers. No native or full integration qualification.

readExtent.tests: Complete 30,532-byte body, all eight methods and complete fixture helpers
readExtent.snapshotView: Complete constructor, hierarchy/raw-array preservation, and identifier predicate
readExtent.definitionCatalog: Complete constructor, identity/key/descriptor lookup and digest path
readExtent.nativeConstructors: Whole fileblocks body; exact template constructors and restrictions, protobuf Block/File/Text/FileInfo declarations and native JSON serializer. Whole downloaded body identities independently verified.
readExtent.variant: Original path and plaintext/native-checksum distinction read in exact source; no private payload read

literalCorrectionVerification.execution: Pure text reconstruction in V8, not Swift parsing or execution

findings.name: Positive constructor path
findings.conclusion: The synthetic source identifiers, unique keys, type URLs, descriptor formats, source hashes and hierarchy satisfy the actual SnapshotView and Catalog constructors. Catalog descriptors cover all positive owner/head detail keys. File type is native 533, ot-file/layout 6, with generated root/header/title/featuredRelations/file/info/relation structure.
findings.details: SnapshotView permits non-control Unicode identifiers up to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. The composed Unicode positive head therefore reaches the new planner, unlike an ASCII-only identifier fixture. Raw block rows remain in serialization order; depthFirstIDs is separately derived.

findings.name: Native generated-head shape
findings.conclusion: The selected generated subset matches the retained constructor and protobuf declarations: read=false and edit/remove/drag/dropOn=true; Header=3, Title=7, File=1, Done=2, Auto=0; File size and addedAt are int64 decimal strings; root/header child edges and optional nonzero relation rows are exact.
findings.details: The self file block points to the source head, not to the payload ID. Title detail fields and the File Information bold mark are checked. Original /0/ variant and explicit metadata shape are required. Arbitrary extra head metadata, legacy type 256, specialized layout, extra FileKeys and changed block content refuse.

findings.name: Actual-index/self/detail closure
findings.conclusion: The native enumerator uses the original Snapshot.Blocks index. The independent fixture transcription uses its own raw array. The test moves file from raw index 4 to 9 with unchanged depth-first index 4, accepts only the new exact reference row and rejects the stale index.
findings.details: Positive one-file fixture has exactly the fileInfo self row, self file-block row and owning document detail row. Missing self/detail rows, payload substituted as head, foreign owner, duplicate, LegacyFileID=true and unknown fields each refuse through incompleteReferences. Native sort order is owner/field/payload UTF-8 order.

findings.name: Ownership and value fidelity
findings.conclusion: Distinct source head, payload and document owner remain separate. One destination file item is attributed to its document owner and a deterministic file source key; reference encoding uses fileID/fileURI. Repeated detail references retain order and multiplicity. Equal payload bytes in distinct source identities are not deduplicated.
findings.details: Two owners of one head, two heads sharing one payload, an unreferenced head and duplicate variants refuse at their intended typed layer. No upload or destination write is performed.

findings.name: Typed refusal reachability
findings.conclusion: Negative mutations are admitted by earlier fixture constructors before reaching the intended planner checks, except deliberately malformed source binding which stops at sourceBinding. The numeric File size mutation stays a valid SnapshotView and reaches generated block refusal. Changed view bytes and byte-different Unicode references reach changedProperty or incompleteReferences as declared.
findings.details: Changed catalog descriptor bytes alter the catalog binding and require refuses. Empty projection verifies no file items/schema attribution, without claiming complete legacy v1 byte equivalence.

limitations: All eight methods remain unparsed, uncompiled and unrun by this peer.
The synthetic opaque protobuf and metadata values are not native protobuf decoding, checksum verification, decryption, capture provenance or account authority.
The public initializer taking the complete verified bundle and selected live content is outside the executed scope; this source peer does not claim it has run.
No producer/content hook has been applied or qualified by these files.
Anchored payload materialization, native upload/current authority, a real nonempty capture and end-to-end migration remain separate obligations.
Full original source/head/schema retention is a contract obligation; this projection neither activates File Type nor proves native history migration.
Review of a closed generic constructor subset is not a global support claim for custom file-head metadata or specialized media.
